cond_0001.intro: Performs a wide spectrum of both diagnostic and therapeutic nuclear medicine procedures that require the safe and effective utilization of radioactive materials in patients of all ages.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Assists the nuclear physician in the use of radionuclides for therapeutic purposes using prescribed safety standards and in accordance with the QMP Quality Management Program submitted to the Nuclear Regulatory Commission
Demonstrates knowledge of the Medical Center s and Department s policies
Makes decisions based on good judgment and the patient s condition to best service the patient and the Medical Center
Demonstrates knowledge of the hospital SMS system; is able to enter/delete orders, complete orders and charges, check patient status and information
Maintains adequate and accurate records of radionuclide receipt, administration, usage, storage, and disposal in accordance with state and federal regulations
Maintains the Department in a contamination free and orderly state
Maintains the Department in a state of regulatory compliance at all times
Participates in the Department s Performance Improvement PI efforts by improving one s own performance, seeking opportunities for Department improvement, and participating in PI activities
Performs diagnostic nuclear medicine procedures on patients inclusive of organ imaging and function studies
Prepares and administers radiopharmaceuticals to patients demonstrating knowledge of and adherence to state and federal regulations and 797 standards
Documents radiopharmaceutical administration data in the [Product name masked] computer system including adverse reaction and pregnancy breast feeding status
Prepares studies for interpretation ensuring that all proper dosage information, patient history, diagnostic information, image labeling, formatting, associated paperwork, and transfer to the PAC system is complete
Provides protection to oneself and others in accordance with the ALARA As Low As Reasonably Achievable philosophy and in accordance with state and federal regulations
Sets up equipment and positions patients for bone mineral density studies in accordance with Departmental procedures
Supports the Patient1st philosophy and is active in measures taken by the Department to increase patient safety and satisfaction
Maintains a professional attitude towards physicians, patients, visitors, and co-workers
Upon completion of a procedure properly cleans and organizes the room and performs any necessary equipment cleaning in accordance with Departmental policies
Verifies patients identification in accordance with hospital policies, checks physicians orders, and verifies appropriateness of study prior to the administration of any radionuclide
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Graduate of an AMA accredited Nuclear Medicine program
Must hold or be eligible for a [Location masked] state license in Nuclear Medicine Technology
Registered or registry eligible by the American Registry of Radiology Technologists Nuclear Medicine ARRT--N or the Nuclear Medicine Technology Certification Board NMTCB
Preferred Requirements
Maintains BLS Health Care Provider course completion status

cond_0190.intro: Performs a wide spectrum of both diagnostic and therapeutic nuclear medicine procedures that require the safe and effective utilization of radioactive materials in patients of all ages
cond_0190.responsibilities:

Maintains a professional attitude towards physicians, patients, visitors, and co-workers
Upon completion of a procedure properly cleans and organizes the room and performs any necessary equipment cleaning in accordance with Departmental policies
Verifies patients identification in accordance with hospital policies, checks physicians orders, and verifies appropriateness of study prior to the administration of any radionuclide

cond_0225.intro: Performs a wide spectrum of both diagnostic and therapeutic nuclear medicine procedures that require the safe and effective utilization of radioactive materials in patients of all ages.
cond_0225.responsibilities:
Assists the nuclear physician in the use of radionuclides for therapeutic purposes using prescribed safety standards and in accordance with the QMP Quality Management Program submitted to the Nuclear Regulatory Commission
Shares knowledge of the Medical Center's and Department's policies with the team and applies them consistently
Works with the care team to make decisions based on good judgment and the patient's condition to best serve the patient and the Medical Center
Coordinates with staff using the hospital SMS system; is able to enter/delete orders, complete orders and charges, check patient status and information
Maintains adequate and accurate records of radionuclide receipt, administration, usage, storage, and disposal in accordance with state and federal regulations
Works with colleagues to keep the Department in a contamination free and orderly state
Helps ensure the Department remains in a state of regulatory compliance at all times
Participates in the Department's Performance Improvement PI efforts by improving one's own performance, seeking opportunities for Department improvement, and participating in PI activities
Performs diagnostic nuclear medicine procedures on patients inclusive of organ imaging and function studies
Prepares and administers radiopharmaceuticals to patients demonstrating knowledge of and adherence to state and federal regulations and 797 standards
Documents radiopharmaceutical administration data in the [Product name masked] computer system including adverse reaction and pregnancy breast feeding status
Prepares studies for interpretation ensuring that all proper dosage information, patient history, diagnostic information, image labeling, formatting, associated paperwork, and transfer to the PAC system is complete
Supports protection for oneself and others in accordance with the ALARA As Low As Reasonably Achievable philosophy and in accordance with state and federal regulations
Sets up equipment and positions patients for bone mineral density studies in accordance with Departmental procedures
Supports the Patient1st philosophy and works alongside the Department in measures taken to increase patient safety and satisfaction
Maintains a professional attitude towards physicians, patients, visitors, and co-workers
Upon completion of a procedure properly cleans and organizes the room and performs any necessary equipment cleaning in accordance with Departmental policies
Coordinates with staff to verify patients identification in accordance with hospital policies, checks physicians orders, and verifies appropriateness of study prior to the administration of any radionuclide
cond_0225.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Graduate of an AMA accredited Nuclear Medicine program
Must hold or be eligible for a [Location masked] state license in Nuclear Medicine Technology
Registered or registry eligible by the American Registry of Radiology Technologists Nuclear Medicine ARRT--N or the Nuclear Medicine Technology Certification Board NMTCB
Preferred Requirements
Maintains BLS Health Care Provider course completion status

People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of nuclear medicine procedures and the regulations that govern them.
cond_0256.responsibilities:
Assists the nuclear physician in the use of radionuclides for therapeutic purposes using prescribed safety standards and in accordance with the QMP Quality Management Program submitted to the Nuclear Regulatory Commission
Demonstrates knowledge of the Medical Center s and Department s policies
Makes decisions based on good judgment and the patient s condition to best service the patient and the Medical Center
Demonstrates knowledge of the hospital SMS system; is able to enter/delete orders, complete orders and charges, check patient status and information
Maintains adequate and accurate records of radionuclide receipt, administration, usage, storage, and disposal in accordance with state and federal regulations
Maintains the Department in a contamination free and orderly state
Maintains the Department in a state of regulatory compliance at all times
Participates in the Department s Performance Improvement PI efforts by improving one s own performance, seeking opportunities for Department improvement, and participating in PI activities
Performs diagnostic nuclear medicine procedures on patients inclusive of organ imaging and function studies
Prepares and administers radiopharmaceuticals to patients demonstrating knowledge of and adherence to state and federal regulations and 797 standards
Documents radiopharmaceutical administration data in the [Product name masked] computer system including adverse reaction and pregnancy breast feeding status
Prepares studies for interpretation ensuring that all proper dosage information, patient history, diagnostic information, image labeling, formatting, associated paperwork, and transfer to the PAC system is complete
Provides protection to oneself and others in accordance with the ALARA As Low As Reasonably Achievable philosophy and in accordance with state and federal regulations
Sets up equipment and positions patients for bone mineral density studies in accordance with Departmental procedures
Supports the Patient1st philosophy and is active in measures taken by the Department to increase patient safety and satisfaction
Maintains a professional attitude towards physicians, patients, visitors, and co-workers
Upon completion of a procedure properly cleans and organizes the room and performs any necessary equipment cleaning in accordance with Departmental policies
Verifies patients identification in accordance with hospital policies, checks physicians orders, and verifies appropriateness of study prior to the administration of any radionuclide
cond_0256.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Graduate of an AMA accredited Nuclear Medicine program
Must hold or be eligible for a [Location masked] state license in Nuclear Medicine Technology
Registered or registry eligible by the American Registry of Radiology Technologists Nuclear Medicine ARRT--N or the Nuclear Medicine Technology Certification Board NMTCB
Preferred Requirements
Maintains BLS Health Care Provider course completion status
cond_0256.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0362.intro: Performs a wide spectrum of both diagnostic and therapeutic nuclear medicine procedures that require the safe and effective utilization of radioactive materials in patients of all ages
cond_0362.responsibilities:
Assists the nuclear physician in the use of radionuclides for therapeutic purposes using prescribed safety standards and in accordance with the QMP Quality Management Program submitted to the Nuclear Regulatory Commission
Demonstrates knowledge of the Medical Center s and Department s policies
Makes decisions based on good judgment and the patient s condition to best service the patient and the Medical Center
Demonstrates knowledge of the hospital SMS system; is able to enter/delete orders, complete orders and charges, check patient status and information
Maintains adequate and accurate records of radionuclide receipt, administration, usage, storage, and disposal in accordance with state and federal regulations
Maintains the Department in a contamination free and orderly state
Maintains the Department in a state of regulatory compliance at all times
Participates in the Department s Performance Improvement PI efforts by improving one s own performance, seeking opportunities for Department improvement, and participating in PI activities
Performs diagnostic nuclear medicine procedures on patients inclusive of organ imaging and function studies
Prepares and administers radiopharmaceuticals to patients demonstrating knowledge of and adherence to state and federal regulations and 797 standards
Documents radiopharmaceutical administration data in the [Product name masked] computer system including adverse reaction and pregnancy breast feeding status
Prepares studies for interpretation ensuring that all proper dosage information, patient history, diagnostic information, image labeling, formatting, associated paperwork, and transfer to the PAC system is complete
Provides protection to oneself and others in accordance with the ALARA As Low As Reasonably Achievable philosophy and in accordance with state and federal regulations
Sets up equipment and positions patients for bone mineral density studies in accordance with Departmental procedures
Supports the Patient1st philosophy and is active in measures taken by the Department to increase patient safety and satisfaction
Maintains a professional attitude towards physicians, patients, visitors, and co-workers
Upon completion of a procedure properly cleans and organizes the room and performs any necessary equipment cleaning in accordance with Departmental policies
Verifies patients identification in accordance with hospital policies, checks physicians orders, and verifies appropriateness of study prior to the administration of any radionuclide
cond_0362.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Graduate of an AMA accredited Nuclear Medicine program; advanced degree strongly preferred
Demonstrated expertise in Nuclear Medicine Technology with proven eligibility for [Location masked] state licensure
Active BLS Health Care Provider certification
Preferred Requirements
Full registration (rather than registry eligibility) by the American Registry of Radiology Technologists Nuclear Medicine ARRT--N or the Nuclear Medicine Technology Certification Board NMTCB

cond_0501.intro: We are looking for a Nuclear Medicine Technologist to join our team. The role involves performing a wide spectrum of both diagnostic and therapeutic nuclear medicine procedures that require the safe and effective use of radioactive materials in patients of all ages.
cond_0501.responsibilities:
Assists the nuclear physician in the use of radionuclides for therapeutic purposes using prescribed safety standards and in accordance with the QMP Quality Management Program submitted to the Nuclear Regulatory Commission
Demonstrates knowledge of the Medical Center's and Department's policies
Makes decisions based on good judgment and the patient's condition to best service the patient and the Medical Center
Demonstrates knowledge of the hospital SMS system; is able to enter/delete orders, complete orders and charges, check patient status and information
Maintains adequate and accurate records of radionuclide receipt, administration, usage, storage, and disposal in accordance with state and federal regulations
Maintains the Department in a contamination free and orderly state
Maintains the Department in a state of regulatory compliance at all times
Participates in the Department's Performance Improvement PI efforts by improving one's own performance, seeking opportunities for Department improvement, and actively contributing to PI activities
Performs diagnostic nuclear medicine procedures on patients inclusive of organ imaging and function studies
Prepares and administers radiopharmaceuticals to patients demonstrating knowledge of and adherence to state and federal regulations and 797 standards
Documents radiopharmaceutical administration data in the [Product name masked] computer system including adverse reaction and pregnancy breast feeding status
Prepares studies for interpretation ensuring that all proper dosage information, patient history, diagnostic information, image labeling, formatting, associated paperwork, and transfer to the PAC system is complete
Provides protection to oneself and others in accordance with the ALARA As Low As Reasonably Achievable philosophy and in accordance with state and federal regulations
Sets up equipment and positions patients for bone mineral density studies in accordance with Departmental procedures
Supports the Patient1st philosophy and is active in measures taken by the Department to increase patient safety and satisfaction; regularly communicates with patients and staff to support a safe, positive experience
Maintains a professional attitude towards physicians, patients, visitors, and co-workers, and stays in regular contact with the care team throughout the day
Upon completion of a procedure properly cleans and organizes the room and performs any necessary equipment cleaning in accordance with Departmental policies
Verifies patients identification in accordance with hospital policies, checks physicians orders, and verifies appropriateness of study prior to the administration of any radionuclide; initiates contact with the ordering physician when clarification is needed
cond_0501.requirements:
Graduate of an AMA accredited Nuclear Medicine program
Must hold or be eligible for a [Location masked] state license in Nuclear Medicine Technology
Registered or registry eligible by the American Registry of Radiology Technologists Nuclear Medicine ARRT--N or the Nuclear Medicine Technology Certification Board NMTCB
Maintains BLS Health Care Provider course completion status

Graduate of an AMA accredited Nuclear Medicine program
Must hold or be eligible for a [Location masked] state license in Nuclear Medicine Technology
Registered or registry eligible by the American Registry of Radiology Technologists Nuclear Medicine ARRT--N or the Nuclear Medicine Technology Certification Board NMTCB
Preferred Requirements
Maintains BLS Health Care Provider course completion status

cond_0640.intro: Performs a wide spectrum of both diagnostic and therapeutic nuclear medicine procedures that require the safe and effective utilization of radioactive materials in patients of all ages
cond_0640.responsibilities:
Assists the nuclear physician in the use of radionuclides for therapeutic purposes using prescribed safety standards and in accordance with the QMP Quality Management Program submitted to the Nuclear Regulatory Commission
Demonstrates knowledge of the Medical Center s and Department s policies
Makes decisions based on good judgment and the patient s condition to best service the patient and the Medical Center
Demonstrates knowledge of the hospital SMS system; is able to enter/delete orders, complete orders and charges, check patient status and information
Maintains adequate and accurate records of radionuclide receipt, administration, usage, storage, and disposal in accordance with state and federal regulations
Maintains the Department in a contamination free and orderly state
Maintains the Department in a state of regulatory compliance at all times
Participates in the Department s Performance Improvement PI efforts by improving one s own performance, seeking opportunities for Department improvement, and participating in PI activities
Performs diagnostic nuclear medicine procedures on patients inclusive of organ imaging and function studies
Prepares and administers radiopharmaceuticals to patients demonstrating knowledge of and adherence to state and federal regulations and 797 standards
Documents radiopharmaceutical administration data in the [Product name masked] computer system including adverse reaction and pregnancy breast feeding status
Prepares studies for interpretation ensuring that all proper dosage information, patient history, diagnostic information, image labeling, formatting, associated paperwork, and transfer to the PAC system is complete
Provides protection to oneself and others in accordance with the ALARA As Low As Reasonably Achievable philosophy and in accordance with state and federal regulations
Sets up equipment and positions patients for bone mineral density studies in accordance with Departmental procedures
Supports the Patient1st philosophy and is active in measures taken by the Department to increase patient safety and satisfaction
Maintains a professional attitude towards physicians, patients, visitors, and co-workers
Upon completion of a procedure properly cleans and organizes the room and performs any necessary equipment cleaning in accordance with Departmental policies
Verifies patients identification in accordance with hospital policies, checks physicians orders, and verifies appropriateness of study prior to the administration of any radionuclide
